Original Decipher card face for [[Dark Rage]] (Reflections III), as shown in the card list on Decipher's own website.

Source: [http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/reflections3/dark/images/darkrage.jpg darkrage.jpg], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020311083013/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/reflections3/dark/images/darkrage.jpg Internet Archive], 11 March 2002. SHA-256 of the archived file: 6a65f6a5e29326b692cff9079dc6411b790fea946e0bbce49f8ab7995a96c1a7.

Edits: none. The file is the archived JPG byte for byte.

This replaces [[:File:Ref3-D-darkrage-pc2007.gif]] (formerly misnamed ReflectionsIII-D-darkrage-decipher-archive.gif), which is a Players Committee copy, not Decipher's scan. The PC Holotable face is [[:File:Ref3-D-darkrage.gif]] and is not replaced by this file.
